title: The handoff-unread guard refuses a reply until an Audit: agent has started after a compaction
why: Retro 12:17 CST Nov 13: it skipped the post-compaction audit (handoff Next 5, ruling audit-reads-main-every-role) and the owner caught it; no check starts it before the first reply.
note: Todo. Extend the handoff-unread guard so a session's first reply after a compaction is refused until an `Audit:` agent has started. Guard that would have stopped the miss. Check the guard record (building-guard-needs-incident) first: incident = the retro's skipped audit this compaction.
